 The forgotten Power Four conference, the ACC still has the nation's No. 1 team in Miami .
 Wake Forest and SMU are 15th and 16th, respectively in the latest US LBM Coaches Poll . Well, the Mustangs maybe were looking ahead to next week's game vs. Virginia Tech and lost 30-27 at Syracuse. That won't help fellow conference mates looking to improve their College Football Playoff resumes.
 Toppmeyer: Miami thinks ACC is ‘second tier.’ That’s exactly why Hurricanes should stay Week 9 schedule is a trap: These 7 games could blow everything up Clemson vs. Florida State , long a marquee ACC game, is an afterthought placed on the ACC Network tonight. The heat on Mike Norvell or Dabo Swinney will only increase for tonight's loser.
